verdict.rationale: Railway clearly delivers no-server-management deployment for full-stack apps (auto-config, infra abstraction, scaling, networking) per docs-1, docs-4-6, docs-18, but there's no evidence of a serverless/FaaS function deployment model—Railway is container/service-based, not function-as-a-service. Community reports also raise doubts about platform reliability, undercutting the 'no servers to manage' worry-free framing.
